_comment: The ONE place the homepage figures are set. scripts/check-metrics.mjs fails the build if index.html disagrees with this file, so a number cannot drift in the page without drifting here first. Update this, run `npm run metrics:check`, then edit the page.
source: docs/CLAIMS.md and the pillar list in the CAIRN source repository

governedPillars.label: governed pillars
governedPillars.basis: PATH, CAIRN, COMPASS, ATLAS, FORGE, CRUCIBLE, BEACON

deployment.label: deployment
deployment.basis: no CAIRN-operated server is involved in a customer deployment

gateCost.label: to evaluate a policy decision
gateCost.basis: measured with the published gate-cost methodology against CAIRN Trust Fabric 2.10.1; the same figure the Architecture section states

_removed.automatedTests: Removed 2026-09-06. The page carried '2,856 automated tests' under a heading reading 'Live Telemetry' while the real figure was 3,303 — a number that had drifted by 447 and was never live. It is also the one figure CAIRN's own register discipline forbids as a headline: a test count is a measurement, never readiness. If a volume figure is wanted here, it must be one that does not rot and does not invite that reading.
_removed.trackedClaims: Removed 2026-09-06 with register.html. The strip read '143 claims in the public register' and there is no public register any more, so the figure described a surface a reader cannot reach. A number that is accurate about an internal document and false about this site is the defect this file exists to prevent.
_removed.claimsBreakdown: Removed 2026-09-06 with the homepage register extract: Works 92, Partial 37, Never 5, Roadmap 9. Kept here so a later session can see what the figures were rather than recounting.
